messages:
Alex: quick one — customer on Windows hit bundler+ssl errors when running the ruby sampleapp. opened a tiny PR with a suggested README fix and a CI smoke job.
Priya: link?
Alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/420 - summary: document installing msys2 devkit, add openssl cert instructions, and add a windows-smoke job that runs bundle install && ruby sampleapp/start.rb
Tom: saw CI failure in the first run: native ext build tried to compile and failed because devkit not installed on the runner. CI bot log shows "gcc: not found"
CI-Bot: build #2001 failed on windows-latest — error: gcc: not found (log excerpt: "Installing ruby native extensions... FAILED")
Mei: we shouldn't require native build for the smoke job. Can the job use the pure-ruby fallback or skip ext compilation? Safer for onboarding docs to show the quick path, not force devkit install.
Alex: updated PR to prefer pure-ruby fallback in the sampleapp Dockerfile and GH action. added a note in README: "Windows devs: install MSYS2 + devkit if you need the native ext, otherwise run with PURE_RUBY=1 for quick testing"
Priya: nice. Also add a short troubleshooting snippet about Windows cert store — some users need to run `ridk install` or add `SSL_CERT_FILE` env var pointing to cacert.pem
Alex: added that note and a one-liner to download cacert.pem to sampleapp/certs and export SSL_CERT_FILE in the example start script
Tom: can you include a tiny test that stubs the ext build and ensures sampleapp still boots under PURE_RUBY=1? prevents regressions
Alex: added spec/boot_smoke_spec.rb that runs the sampleapp start script under PURE_RUBY=1 and asserts it binds to the mock port. kept it fast and hermetic
Mei: once CI passes and docs wording tightened, lgtm. Thanks for doing the Windows flow — will save on support tickets.
CI-Bot: build #2002 queued
Alex: thanks all, will squash and merge after CI
